verdict.rationale: Oracle's docs clearly spell out a $300/30-day Free Trial and an Always Free tier that 'never expires,' with resources surviving upgrade to paid (oracle-cloud-docs-10/11/24/29/12). However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict the 'always free, no hidden limits' framing: accounts have been reclaimed after 7 days of low utilization, banned for bandwidth/CPU overuse, and required a CPU-spiking cronjob workaround to avoid shutdown—none of which are spelled out in the published terms (oracle-cloud-comm-1, oracle-cloud-comm-3, oracle-cloud-comm-4, oracle-cloud-comm-5). Missing for 10: an official published document detailing the exact idle/utilization thresholds that trigger reclamation or bans, and reconciliation of the 'never expires' claim with real enforcement practices.
